Howard's Personal-Best Yellowfin Tuna in San José del Cabo

Fishing Report Dec 30 Written by EXOTIC FISH-CABO

A Personal-Best Yellowfin Tuna Before the New Year

December 2025 brought an unforgettable fishing experience for Howard, who traveled from Connecticut to enjoy the waters of San José del Cabo.

Trading the winter temperatures of New England for the warmer climate of Baja California Sur, Howard joined Exotic Fish Cabo for a private offshore fishing adventure.

Departing early from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, the trip began as the sun rose over the Sea of Cortez.

The crew set the trolling lines and began searching for yellowfin tuna in offshore waters.

It wasn't long before one of the rods bent sharply under the pressure of a powerful strike.

Howard took the rod, beginning an intense battle with a large yellowfin tuna, one of the region's most sought-after game fish.

The fish remained deep for much of the fight, using its strength to make repeated runs and resist being brought toward the surface.

Howard stayed focused, maintaining steady pressure and recovering line whenever the opportunity appeared.

With guidance and assistance from the crew, he gradually worked the powerful tuna closer to the boat.

Eventually, the unmistakable silver and yellow colors of the fish appeared beneath the surface.

After a demanding battle, the crew successfully brought the tuna aboard.

For Howard, it was a remarkable achievement: the biggest yellowfin tuna he had ever caught.

What began as a winter getaway from Connecticut had turned into a personal fishing milestone and a story worth sharing for years to come.

Sometimes, the greatest fishing memories are about more than the size of the catch. They're about patience, determination, and the excitement of achieving something you've never experienced before.

Trip Highlights

  • Date: December 2025

  • Departure: Puerto Los Cabos Marina, San José del Cabo

  • Angler: Howard, visiting from Connecticut

  • Species caught: Yellowfin tuna

  • Fishing technique: Offshore trolling

  • Catch highlight: Howard's personal-best yellowfin tuna

  • Experience: Private offshore fishing charter

Yellowfin tuna are known for their powerful runs, remarkable endurance, and ability to dive deep during a fight.

Their activity around San José del Cabo depends on ocean currents, water temperatures, baitfish availability, and seasonal conditions.

Every fishing trip is different, and catches are never guaranteed.
